note: Single source of truth for third-party code and pinned dev tools. 'commit' is the pin; 'ref' is for humans. See specs/build-system.md B-7 and B-14, and docs/dependencies.md.

dependencies.name: imgui
dependencies.why: Immediate-mode UI with docking; multi-viewport off (windowing.md W-6)

dependencies.name: sdl3
dependencies.why: Native windows, input, the OpenGL context, and the hit test behind the custom title bar; one library for Windows, macOS, X11 and Wayland (windowing.md W-1)
patches: third_party/patches/sdl3/0001-hit-test-at-press.patch: X11 and Wayland ask the hit test again at the press, and Wayland reports the press as a hit-test event as X11 does; together they let a double-click on the title bar maximize without starting a move (windowing.md §4)

dependencies.name: doctest
dependencies.why: Test framework: one header, the fastest-compiling of the common frameworks, per-case CTest discovery (specs/testing.md T-1)

dependencies.name: tracy
dependencies.why: Profiler client (profile builds only) and the matching profiler GUI/CLI tools; one pin keeps client and GUI protocol identical
